title: Autonomous DevOps Pipeline: Jules + Antigravity + Chrome DevTools
description: DanielaOS orchestrates a full DevOps pipeline: Chrome DevTools for Agents detects a frontend bug → Antigravity schedules a GUARDIAN agent task → GUARDIAN dispatches Jules to fix → Jules opens PR → DanielaOS reviews and merges. Fully autonomous bug detection, fix, and deployment with zero human intervention.
impact: DanielaOS becomes a self-healing system. Bugs are detected, fixed, and deployed before users even notice them.

title: Content Factory 2.0: Gemini Deep Research + AI Studio Workspace + Chrome Auto Browse
description: Monthly pipeline: Gemini Deep Research generates industry trend report → AI Studio Managed Agent creates content draft → Docs API formats it → Chrome Auto Browse publishes to all platforms → social media agents schedule posts. Full content creation and distribution pipeline runs autonomously.
impact: Monthly content production and distribution fully automated. Research → create → format → publish → promote, all without human intervention.

title: Web-Native Agent Platform: WebMCP + Built-in AI + Managed Agents
description: AIGestion's web interface becomes a WebMCP server. Browser agents discover AIGestion's tools natively. Built-in Prompt API handles lightweight on-device tasks (summaries, translations). Heavy reasoning escalates to Managed Agents in the cloud. Three-tier AI: on-device (free) → API (cheap) → Managed Agent (powerful).
impact: AIGestion is the first web-native agent platform. Browser agents can use it without any setup. Three-tier cost optimization keeps operations nearly free.

title: Full-Stack Autonomous Development: Jules + AI Studio Android + Firebase
description: User describes a feature in chat → Jules implements backend code → AI Studio generates Android app update → Firebase deploys backend functions → Play Console publishes test build → DanielaOS notifies user for testing. Full-stack feature delivery: backend + frontend + mobile + deploy in one flow.
impact: Feature idea to deployed full-stack app in hours, not weeks. The entire development pipeline is agent-driven.

title: 2M-Context Architecture Evolution: Gemini Pro + Antigravity + Jules
description: Gemini 3.5 Pro analyzes entire codebase (2M context) → identifies architecture improvements → Antigravity schedules parallel refactoring tasks → Jules implements each refactoring PR independently → DanielaOS reviews and merges. Architecture evolves autonomously based on full-project understanding.
impact: DanielaOS doesn't just maintain code — it evolves the architecture. The system improves itself over time with full-context awareness.
